values: User opens the Zentra web landing page and confirms the main public content loads.

1. Open http://localhost:3000/.
2. Wait for the landing page to load.
3. Review the hero, spaces, features, reservation, testimonials, and partners sections.
Landing page returned 200 and the implemented home sections are available.
User opens the web navigation menu and sees available public links.

1. Open the home page.
2. Hover or tap the menu icon.
3. Confirm the side menu displays Home, Packages, Gallery, About Us, Contact Us, FAQ, Rules & Regulation, and Book Now.
Menu structure matches the implemented Navbar component.
User expands the Packages menu and sees each event package option.

1. Open the menu.
2. Hover over Packages.
3. Confirm Weddings, Debuts, Christening, Birthdays, Gender Reveal, and Christmas Party are listed.
All implemented package links are present in the navigation.
User navigates to the About Us page.

1. Open /about.
2. Confirm the page title and experience content display.
User views contact details and social/contact links.

1. Open /contact.
2. Confirm email, phone, social links, and map/location entry are shown.
Route returned 200 and contact UI is implemented.

1. Open /faq.
2. Confirm help content is displayed.
User views venue rules and regulations.

1. Open /rules.
2. Confirm rules and regulation content is displayed.
User opens the Privacy Policy page.

1. Open /privacy.
2. Confirm data privacy content is displayed.
User opens the Terms of Service page.

1. Open /terms.
2. Confirm terms content is displayed.
User opens the Weddings package page and reviews package content.

1. Open /events/weddings.
2. Confirm hero, content blocks, spaces, package panel, and gallery render.
User opens the Debuts package page.

1. Open /events/debuts.
2. Confirm package content and gallery render.
User opens the Christening package page.

1. Open /events/christening.
2. Confirm package content and gallery render.
User opens the Birthdays package page.

1. Open /events/birthdays.
2. Confirm package content and gallery render.
User opens the Gender Reveal package page.

1. Open /events/gender-reveal.
2. Confirm package content and gallery render.
User opens the Christmas Party package page.

1. Open /events/christmas-party.
2. Confirm package content and gallery render.
User opens the Book Now flow.

1. Open /book.
2. Confirm the booking hero and first wizard step display.
Route returned 200 and BookFlow is rendered.
User selects an event type in the booking wizard.

1. From /book, select an event card such as Wedding.
2. Confirm the selected card shows a checkmark.
3. Confirm the wizard moves to the date step.
Event type selection updates form data and advances to step 2.
User selects an available event date.

1. On the date step, review available and booked dates.
2. Attempt to use only an available date.
3. Confirm the selected date is highlighted.
Date component blocks past/booked dates and stores the selected date.
User selects a theme for the event.

1. Continue to the theme step.
2. Select Minimalist, Garden, Elegant, or Modern Luxury.
3. Confirm selected state is displayed.
Theme selection updates the booking form state.

1. Continue to guest count.
2. Select 30-50, 50-75, 75-100, or 100+.
3. Confirm selected state is displayed.
Guest count selection updates the booking form state.

1. Continue to preferred time.
2. Select Luminous, Zenith, Golden Hour, or Starlit.
3. Confirm selected state is displayed.
Time selection updates the booking form state.

1. Continue to budget range.
2. Select one of the four budget cards.
3. Confirm selected state is displayed.
Budget selection updates the booking form state.

1. Continue to add-ons.
2. Select Food Carts, Rooms, Photobooth, Ceremony Styling, Photo & Video, or Menu.
3. Select again to confirm toggle behavior.
Add-ons can be selected and removed from form data.
User enters a special request or notes.

1. Continue to notes.
2. Type a special request in the text area.
3. Confirm the character counter updates and text stays within the limit.
Notes field accepts input up to the configured 1000-character limit.
User reviews all booking information before confirmation.

1. Continue to the review step.
2. Confirm event type, date, theme, guests, time, budget, add-ons, and notes are displayed.
3. Click an edit icon and confirm the wizard returns to that step.
Review cards display captured data and support step editing.
User confirms booking and receives generated recommendations.

1. Click Confirm Booking.
2. Wait for the generating screen to complete.
3. Confirm the Signature Narrative and recommended package cards display.
Generating flow advances to the result screen with narrative and package recommendations.
User can enter contact details from the generated package result.

1. On the result screen, type Full Name, Email Address, Facebook, and Phone Number.
2. Click Book this package or Send this to my email.
3. Confirm the form remains usable without page errors.
Result form inputs and action buttons are implemented.
Admin user opens the web admin login portal.

1. Open /admin.
2. Confirm email and password fields, Remember Me, Forgot Password, and Sign In button display.
3. Submit valid test values and confirm navigation to the dashboard.
Admin login UI is implemented and routes to /admin/dashboard on submission.
Admin user views dashboard overview and action widgets.

1. Open /admin/dashboard.
2. Confirm dashboard title, assistant summary, revenue trend, needs-action list, schedule, agenda, and upcoming events display.
Route returned 200 and dashboard widgets are implemented.
Admin user navigates to implemented dashboard modules from the sidebar.

1. Use the admin sidebar.
2. Open Bookings, Contracts, Payments, Calendar, Services, Support, Reports, Audit Logs, and Team.
3. Confirm each implemented module route loads successfully.
Verified implemented admin routes returned 200 after compilation.

values: Showing initial branding screen at app startup

1. Tap on application icon to launch the app
2. Observe the splash screen
3. Wait for splash screen to complete
User navigates to sign in form

1. From the Let's get started screen
click the sign in button, a sign in form will slide upward from user screen
User navigates to sign up form

1. From the Let's get started screen
click the sign up button,  a sign up form will slide upward from user screen
Users need to register themselves in this mobile application.

1. Go to sign-up form
2. Enter a valid first name (at least 2 characters, no numbers or symbols).
3. Enter a valid last name (same rules apply).
4. Enter a valid email (e.g. user@example.com).
5. Enter a strong password (e.g. min 6 characters, includes 1 uppercase letter and 1 number).
6. Type the confirmation of your new password.                                                             
7. Click the Sign up button.
8. A modal will pop up, just click the "Got it!" button  after reading the message.
9. Check email for email verification
10. Confirm email
Email, First Name, Last Name, Password
Users need to register themselves in this mobile application.

1. Go to sign-up form
2. Click "sign-up using Google account"
3. Select your Google account to sign-up
4. Wait for the sign-up authentication that will pop-up after signing up
Connect the hardware component to the mobile application.

1. Turn on the hardware component.
2. Open the device's bluetooth to pair and connect to the mobile device where the application is installed.
3. Open the mobile application to search and pair to the hardware device's bluetooth.
